statement: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall on the US Gulf Coast between 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-16 with a National Hurricane Center landfall intensity of at least 111 mph maximum sustained winds (Category 3 or stronger).

failure_condition: Isaias reaches the US Gulf Coast with landfall winds below 111 mph, or makes no US Gulf Coast landfall between 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-16.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
